explore-coax.title: Make 50 Ω coax
explore-coax.prompt: With solid polyethylene dielectric, set the diameters to make 50 Ω coax.
hints: A thinner centre conductor raises the impedance.
With solid dielectric you need a ratio of about 3.5: try 7 mm and 2 mm.
explore-coax.success: About 3.5 to 1 makes 50 Ω with solid dielectric. A 14 mm cable with a 4 mm centre would be 50 Ω too: only the ratio matters.

explore-cut.title: Cut it in half
explore-cut.prompt: Cut the line down to 10 m and watch the characteristic impedance.
explore-cut.success: Still 50 Ω. The loss goes down with length, but the characteristic impedance doesn't change.

explore-open.title: Open-wire line
explore-open.prompt: Space the wires to make about 450 Ω.
explore-open.success: About 40 to 45 mm apart gives 450 Ω with 2 mm wire.
